from pathlib import Path
checks = {
  'main/gateway_device_state.h': ['typedef struct', 'endpoint_state_t', 'capabilities', 'basic_state'],
  'main/gateway_device_state.c': ['gateway_device_endpoint_state', 'endpoint_state_t'],

for name, needles in checks.items():
    p=Path(name); ls=p.read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines(); print('===', name, '===')

    for i,l in enumerate(ls):
        if any(n in l for n in needles): hits.append(i)
    shown=[]

        lo=max(0,i-8); hi=min(len(ls),i+22)
        if any(lo>=a and hi<=b for a,b in shown): continue
        shown.append((lo,hi)); print('\n'.join(f'{j+1}:{ls[j]}' for j in range(lo,hi)))

    if not p.exists(): print('MISSING'); continue
